courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Volvo 電動公車系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 載具尺度、載荷條件、道路或軌道環境及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vehicle scale, load conditions, road or rail environment and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 以「Shinkansen 0 系高速列車」為案例，逐步分析早期高速列車的氣動、輪軌與分散載荷。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用；列車質量例題指一節虛擬車廂，非完整編組。
courses.summaryEn: Use Shinkansen Series 0 high-speed train to analyze Aerodynamics, wheel–rail contact and distributed loads of an early high-speed train. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces. Train mass examples concern one virtual car, not a full formation.
